categories.hint: The category box on post pages uses the "Summary"
categories.dialogDesc: The category name is the data key: post assignments and site filters match against it. Leave a language's fields empty to show the original text in that language.
categories.name: Category name
categories.short: Summary · the line in the category box
categories.localeDescs: Summary and description in each language · optional
categories.confirmBody: This can't be undone. Posts already in this category aren't affected.

tags.dialogDesc: The tag name is the data key: post tags and site filters match against it. Translations only change how it's shown on each language's pages; leave them empty to show the original name.
tags.name: Tag name
tags.confirmBody: This can't be undone. Posts already tagged with it aren't affected.
